title: ShulkerPreviewer
description: You can see the fully items inside shulker box without opening it.
body:
Supported Versions: 1.20 ~ 26.X

-> Click here to contact us for support <-

---

As a server owner,
I find it despicable when players abuse the fact that shulker boxes
don't reveal all their contents to commit trade scams.

Yes, there are shulker preview mods out there,
but some new players don't know how to install mods —
especially on Bedrock-supported servers, where Bedrock players
have no such resources available at all.
So we built a convenient plugin that lets players see every item inside a shulker box,
giving server players peace of mind — and it causes no server lag!


--- ## 🧩 Features - Preview the hidden items inside a shulker box - Customizable plugin language file - Switches displayed text based on the player's client language - Highly customizable display format - How many items to preview per line - Separator between each item - Prefix at the start of each line - Item preview display format - Whether to merge and show combined amounts --- ## 📥 How to Use - Download this plugin - Drop the `plugin.jar` into your server's plugins folder (`plugins`) - Done! (If you use a plugin loader, remember to `load` the plugin) > ⚠️ If you are on **Windows**, add the following to your server startup arguments, before the `-jar` argument: > `-Dfile.encoding=UTF8` > Otherwise the plugin won't read Chinese and other language files correctly. --- ## ⚙️ Configuration After the plugin starts successfully, you'll find a `config.yml` file in the `plugins/ShulkerPreviewer` directory, which contains all of the plugin's settings. --- ## 💬 Commands - `/shulkerview reload` — Reload the plugin (Permission: **OP**) - `/shulkerview on` — Enable shulker box preview - `/shulkerview off` — Disable shulker box preview --- ## 🔓 Permissions - `command.shulkerview.reload` — Permission to use `/shulkerview reload` - `command.shulkerview.switch` — Permission to use `/shulkerview on/off` --- ## 🧷 Open Source [Github](https://github.com/BrilliantTeam/ShulkerPreviewer) --- ## 🔧 How It Works - When a player **opens** / **closes** a configured container, **picks up a shulker box**, or **switches the item in hand** - The plugin updates the shulker box's **"Lore"** so the preview is displayed --- ## 📢 Notice

Please do not sell plugins developed by the Brilliant Team, or sell their features.
All of our plugins are provided to servers free of charge,
so we earn no real income from developing them.

Such behavior will, to some extent, reduce our willingness to keep developing,
and may lead us to consider turning free, open-source plugins into paid, closed-source ones. We hope you understand.
